label: early copy steps (t=11-13, recall 2-4) of long sequences when echoing p/3/j/u/k/t/m/v
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during the original tokens or at <DEL>), almost entirely at absolute steps t=11-13 while recalling original positions 2-4. In practice that means long sequences (L=9 is 81% of the mass, L=8 is 18%, nothing for L<=6). The fed-back input token matters a lot: p, 3, j, u and k have the highest rates, then t, m and v. The strongest activations are at t=12 (recall_idx 3, L=9) on those tokens, e.g. echoing j or u at step 12. There is a small secondary bump on the last copy step of L=9 sequences. The timing-plus-token predicate covers about 81% of the activation mass but has low precision (~0.34 on dev): many matching steps stay silent, so the token identity is a graded preference rather than a sharp rule. Magnitude is small (max 0.017).
